dedupe_keys.name: scenario based ambulance location model for emergency response with two types of vehicles code for yoon albert and white transportation science 2021

description: This repository publishes the code for a 2021 Transportation Science paper by S. Yoon, L.A. Albert and V.M. White on locating ambulance stations when an emergency medical service runs two types of vehicles. The archived copy read on 2026-09-28 through Software Heritage, last changed in May 2022, holds an original code folder and a revision code folder with two short README files giving the paper's citation and DOI. According to the paper title, the model chooses station locations and vehicles under a set of demand scenarios, treating the two vehicle types separately; the formulation, solver, programming language and test data were not read here. Coverage is generic; the case data used in the paper were not identified. Access is free; no licence file was seen. Caveats: without reading the paper and code, it is unknown whether input data are included or whether a commercial solver is needed. It supports emergency response and capacity planning studies, such as testing where to base two types of ambulance to keep response times within targets across demand scenarios. Related record: the Fez-Meknes ambulance deployment dataset.
name: Scenario-based ambulance location model for emergency response with two types of vehicles (code for Yoon, Albert and White, Transportation Science 2021)
outputs: ambulance station locations and fleet allocation
